rows.title: Ingrid Goes West review
rows.comment: Spicer’s film achieves the highwire humour it seeks
rows.verdict_le10: Spicer’s film achieves the highwire humour it seeks
rows.dek_lead: Through Plaza, Spicer’s film achieves the highwire humour it seeks, but its thematic heft is light and its dual depictions of addiction and mental illness are rooted in a reactionary finger-wagging that leaves its antiheroine more diagnosed
